paragraphs.en: In March 2013, Xi attended the fifth BRICS Summit in Durban, South Africa. It was his first international summit as Chinese president. "We, the five BRICS countries, come from four different continents. The grand goal of fostering partnership for common development and the noble cause of promoting democracy in international relations and advancing peace and development of mankind have brought us together," he said in a keynote speech at the summit. paragraphs.cn: 2013年3月，习近平出席在南非德班举行的金砖国家领导人第五次会晤。那是他作为中国国家主席首次出席国际峰会。他在峰会主旨演讲中说：“我们五国虽然来自四个不同的大陆，但促进共同发展的伙伴关系这一宏大目标，以及推动国际关系民主化、促进人类和平与发展的崇高事业，把我们凝聚在一起。”习近平呼吁金砖国家朝着市场一体化、多层次金融网络、陆海空互联互通、人文交流更加密切的目标迈进。

paragraphs.en: Two years later, at the seventh BRICS Summit held in Ufa, Russia, Xi called for building a partnership for world peace, common development, inter-civilization dialogue and more effective global economic governance. 俄罗斯战略规划与预测研究所所长亚历山大·古谢夫表示，习近平以“极具建设性的倡议”推进金砖合作，把更多认同多极世界愿景的全球南方国家带入对话与务实合作，从而增强了金砖的吸引力和影响力。如今，金砖已扩展至11个成员国和10个伙伴国，成为推动多极世界和国际关系民主化的一支力量。金砖国家人口占世界近一半，经济总量约占全球30%，贸易额占全球五分之一。埃及国家新闻署第一副署长穆罕默德·侯赛因说：“中国通过平等对话寻求合作的最大公约数，围绕共同利益凝聚共识，不断增强金砖合作的凝聚力和行动力。”圣保罗州立大学政治与经济学教授马科斯·科代罗·皮雷斯表示，金砖是一个潜力巨大的平台，成员之间的优势和差异是一种财富。

皮雷斯说，在深刻变革的世界中，金砖正在放大全球南方国家要求更好治理、更多安全和更大发展权的声音。在中国东南部福建省厦门港这一国际航运重要枢纽，金砖出海直通车于7月底正式启动，为中国企业拓展海外金砖市场提供了新桥梁。首场活动聚焦尼日利亚，该国去年正式成为金砖伙伴国。尼日利亚驻上海总领事馆贸易处处长哈桑·穆罕默德表示，“金砖+”框架创造了更多交流平台，拉近了两国距离。在2020年11月举行的金砖国家领导人第十二次会晤上，习近平宣布中国将在厦门建立金砖国家新工业革命伙伴关系创新基地。

该基地成立以来，已推动100多个合作项目，总投资超过620亿元人民币（92.4亿美元）。它还设立了新兴产业奖学金，帮助金砖国家培养工业、通信等多个领域的人才。务求实效一直是金砖议程的核心。正如习近平所说：“金砖不是清谈馆，而是行动队。”截至2025年底，由习近平亲自推动建立的新开发银行已批准139个项目，融资总额约430亿美元，通过绿色能源、交通基础设施和清洁饮用水等，为全球南方国家人民带来实实在在的好处。

2021年，习近平在第七十六届联合国大会一般性辩论上提出全球发展倡议。五年过去，该倡议与金砖合作机制相互补充、相互促进，把发展进一步推到国际议程的突出位置。此后，中国发起多项倡议，拓展金砖在深海资源、数字经济、绿色产业和清洁能源等领域的合作，还提出人工智能和数字教育等新项目。印度尼西亚加查马达大学讲师西蒂·穆蒂亚·塞蒂亚瓦蒂表示，金砖与全球发展倡议日益相互补充、相互促进。

她说，二者共同推动国际议程更加重视发展，帮助把共同愿景转化为新兴市场和发展中国家的实际成果。去年9月，习近平在中国北方港口城市天津举行的“上海合作组织+”会议上提出全球治理倡议。七天后，习近平在金砖国家领导人线上峰会上发表讲话时说，全球治理倡议“旨在推动全球联合行动，构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系”。金砖国家在从发展到更加多极化的世界、再到全球治理改革等问题上，正日益找到共同点。在2024年金砖峰会上，习近平呼吁把金砖打造成“推动全球治理改革的先锋”。

印度尼赫鲁大学中国与东南亚研究中心中文与中国研究教授B·R·迪帕克表示，全球治理倡议为金砖推进全球治理改革提供了重要框架，有助于加强以联合国为核心的国际体系，使全球治理更加公正、公平、更具代表性。这一愿景也体现在习近平呼吁金砖国家加强合作之中。在俄罗斯喀山“金砖+”领导人对话会上，习近平呼吁金砖国家成为共同发展的主要动力，在全球经济治理改革中发挥积极引领作用，把发展置于国际经贸议程的核心。2018年在南非约翰内斯堡金砖国家工商论坛上，习近平还呼吁金砖国家坚定支持多边贸易体制，推进全球经济治理改革，提高新兴市场和发展中国家的代表性和发言权。在改革主要国际金融机构方面，这些呼吁伴随着具体行动。

金砖国家就国际货币基金组织份额改革和世界银行股权结构改革提出了明确立场。去年在巴西里约热内卢举行的金砖国家领导人第十七次会晤通过的《里约热内卢宣言》强调，国际货币基金组织进一步调整份额应提高新兴市场和发展中经济体的份额。关于世界银行，宣言呼吁“增加发展中国家的发言权和代表性，并以纠正其历史性代表不足的股权调整为基础”。纳尔逊·曼德拉大学经济、发展与旅游学院教授兼院长罗尼·恩夸迪说：“过去二十年，金砖最大的贡献在于改变了关于全球政治治理的讨论。”“金砖表明，新兴和发展中经济体不再只是全球规则的接受者，而是越来越多地参与塑造这些规则。”恩夸迪说。

articles.title: Norway seeks deeper cooperation with China
articles.titleCn: 挪威寻求深化与中国的合作
articles.summary: Norway seeks deeper cooperation with China
articles.summaryCn: 挪威以主宾国身份参加2024年中国国际服务贸易交易会，希望凭借其在海洋、能源和数字技术领域的专长，与中国从单一产品贸易转向知识、技术和综合解决方案的长期合作。

paragraphs.en: h a coastline stretching for more than 100,000 kilometers, including its islands and fjords, Norway has developed deep {{0}} in the complex ocean and energy industries. For generations, the sea has shaped Norway's economy and identity, giving the country deep expertise in shipping, offshore industries and ocean technologies. China, meanwhile, has {{1}} as a global industrial powerhouse, leading the world in shipbuilding and playing a major role in energy and advanced manufacturing. As these industries become greener and smarter, demand is growing for new technologies and {{2}} expertise. For Norway, this opens a new avenue for cooperation with China, bringing not only products, but also knowledge, technology and digital solutions developed through decades of experience in demanding ocean and energy industries.
paragraphs.cn: 挪威拥有绵延超过10万公里的海岸线，包括其岛屿和峡湾，在复杂的海洋和能源产业中积累了深厚的专业知识。几代人以来，海洋塑造了挪威的经济和身份认同，赋予该国在航运、近海产业和海洋技术方面的深厚专长。与此同时，中国已崛起为全球工业强国，在造船业方面领先世界，并在能源和先进制造业中发挥着重要作用。随着这些产业变得更加绿色和智能，对新技术和专业人才的需求不断增长。对挪威而言，这开辟了与中国合作的新途径，带来的不仅是产品，还有数十年在严苛的海洋和能源产业中积累的知识、技术和数字解决方案。

paragraphs.en: That opportunity comes into focus this year at the China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS), where Norway is the Guest Country of Honor. The event runs from September 9 to 13 in Beijing. At its national pavilion, Norwegian companies showcase services and solutions focusing on green energy, digital technology, healthy living products and premium nutrition. The ambition goes beyond selling individual products. Henning Kristoffersen, commercial counsellor at the Norwegian Embassy in China and director of Innovation Norway China, said Norwegian companies hope to move from offering individual products to providing more {{3}} solutions, and from one-off transactions to long-term cooperation.
paragraphs.cn: 这一机遇在今年中国国际服务贸易交易会（服贸会）上成为焦点，挪威是本届服贸会的主宾国。活动于9月9日至13日在北京举行。在挪威国家馆，挪威企业展示了聚焦绿色能源、数字技术、健康生活产品和优质营养的服务与解决方案。其雄心不止于销售单个产品。挪威驻华大使馆商务参赞、挪威创新署中国区总监亨宁·克里斯托弗森表示，挪威企业希望从提供单个产品转向提供更全面的解决方案，从一次性交易转向长期合作。

paragraphs.en:
China is Norway's most important trading partner in Asia. Kristoffersen said the two countries have {{4}} strengths in areas including maritime industries, energy and {{5}} development, while the CIFTIS offers a platform for Norwegian companies to expand their business networks and build long-term partnerships. Greener shipping
For DNV, a Norwegian-founded risk management company, that cooperation has been taking shape for more than a century. It has had a presence in China for nearly 140 years, and its relationship with China's maritime industry began with ship inspection and classification in 1888. It provided independent technical assessments to help ensure that vessels meet required standards.
paragraphs.cn: 中国是挪威在亚洲最重要的贸易伙伴。克里斯托弗森表示，两国在海事产业、能源和可持续发展等领域优势互补，而服贸会为挪威企业拓展商业网络、建立长期伙伴关系提供了平台。更绿色的航运——对于挪威创立的风险管理公司DNV而言，这种合作已经持续了一个多世纪。DNV在中国已有近140年的历史，其与中国海事行业的关系始于1888年的船舶检验和入级。它提供独立的技术评估，帮助确保船舶符合所需标准。

paragraphs.en: Today, however, this partnership extends far beyond inspecting ships. As international laws are demanding the ship industry searches for ways to cut {{6}}, and financiers are also paying greater attention to the environmental performance of vessels, DNV is increasingly working with Chinese shipbuilders and shipowners on designing and building the next generation of vessels. But the path toward greener shipping is far from {{7}}. There is no single alternative fuel suitable for every vessel and every shipping route. The choice depends on factors including the type of ship, where it operates and whether a particular fuel is available along its route.
paragraphs.cn: 然而如今，这一伙伴关系远不止于检验船舶。随着国际法规要求航运业寻找减排途径，金融方也越来越关注船舶的环境表现，DNV正越来越多地与中国造船企业和船东合作，设计和建造新一代船舶。但通往更绿色航运的道路远非一帆风顺。没有一种替代燃料适合每一艘船和每一条航线。选择取决于多种因素，包括船舶类型、运营区域以及航线上是否有特定燃料供应。

paragraphs.en: That {{8}} creates both technological and financial risks. Many companies have adopted a {{9}} approach, building conventional vessels while leaving room for future {{10}}. Chinese shipbuilders and shipowners, however, are increasingly moving directly toward vessels designed to use alternative fuels, according to Norbert Kray, senior vice president and regional manager for Greater China at DNV. This is where DNV says it can play a role. The company is working with Chinese clients earlier in the process, providing technical expertise, data and analysis to help them assess different technological options.
paragraphs.cn: 这种不确定性带来了技术和金融双重风险。许多企业采取了谨慎态度，建造传统船舶的同时为未来改装留出空间。然而，据DNV高级副总裁兼大中华区区域经理诺伯特·克雷介绍，中国造船企业和船东正越来越多地直接转向设计使用替代燃料的船舶。DNV表示，这正是它可以发挥作用的地方。该公司在流程更早的阶段就与中国客户合作，提供技术专长、数据和分析，帮助他们评估不同的技术方案。

paragraphs.en: It helps companies {{11}} uncertainty as they {{12}} to greener shipping. Kray said China's influence on the global transformation of shipping is {{13}}. As Chinese shipbuilders receive more orders for vessels designed to meet new environmental requirements, decisions made in Chinese shipyards are gradually shaping the future of the global maritime industry. If DNV illustrates how a traditional maritime service is evolving to meet the demands of greener shipping, Falkor, a company developing industrial software and digital solutions formerly known as Kongsberg Digital, illustrates another direction: the growing role of digital services in managing complex industrial operations. paragraphs.cn: 它帮助企业在向更绿色航运转型的过程中应对不确定性。克雷表示，中国对全球航运转型的影响力显著。随着中国造船企业获得更多符合新环保要求船舶的订单，中国船厂做出的决策正在逐渐塑造全球海事行业的未来。如果说DNV展示了传统海事服务如何演变以满足更绿色航运的需求，那么Falkor——一家开发工业软件和数字解决方案的公司，前身为康士伯数字——则展示了另一个方向：数字服务在管理复杂工业运营中日益增长的作用。深海一号。

paragraphs.en: 1 (Shenhai-1), China's first independently operated deepwater gas field, lies beneath the South China Sea. At peak production, the field can supply more than 3 billion cubic meters of natural gas a year, providing energy for about 21 million people. Operating a gas field deep beneath the surface leads to challenges that are difficult to see and even harder to manage. On the seabed, temperatures can fall to around 3 degrees Celsius. Low temperatures, combined with the mixture of gas, water and other fluids moving through subsea pipelines, can create risks including hydrate formation and unstable flow.
paragraphs.cn: 深海一号（Shenhai-1）是中国首个自主运营的深水气田，位于南海海底。在高峰产量时，该气田每年可供应超过30亿立方米天然气，为约2100万人提供能源。在海底深处运营气田会带来难以察觉、更难管理的挑战。在海底，温度可降至约3摄氏度。低温加上天然气、水和其他流体在海底管道中流动的混合物，可能产生水合物形成和流动不稳定等风险。

paragraphs.en:
In such an environment, operators cannot simply wait for something to go wrong before responding. This is where the Norwegian company steps in, using a digital model to create a virtual representation of the gas field's highly complex physical operations. This can {{14}} different operating conditions, collect data and give engineers a clearer picture of the operation, helping them make decisions before problems arise. It can also support decisions about pipeline cleaning, {{15}} operating parameters and analyze energy consumption. Sorting salmon
The broader shift in China-Norway cooperation can be seen not only in large industrial projects, but also in efforts to address environmental challenges.
paragraphs.cn: 在这样的环境中，运营方不能等到出了问题才做出反应。这正是这家挪威公司介入的地方，它使用数字模型创建气田高度复杂物理运营的虚拟表示。这可以模拟不同的运营条件，收集数据，让工程师更清晰地了解运营状况，帮助他们在问题出现之前做出决策。它还可以支持管道清洗决策、优化运营参数并分析能耗。三文鱼分拣——中挪合作的更广泛转变不仅体现在大型工业项目中，也体现在应对环境挑战的努力中。

paragraphs.en: Norway is home to countless rivers where wild Atlantic salmon migrate upstream to spawn. But the country's wild salmon populations have faced growing pressure in recent decades, from {{16}} humpback, or pink salmon that compete with native fish for habitat and food, and also climate change and human activity. According to the Norwegian Environment Agency, more than 480,000 pink salmon were caught or observed in Norwegian rivers in 2023, exceeding the number of wild Atlantic salmon that returned to Norway's rivers to spawn in 2024. Removing the invasive fish has traditionally relied heavily on volunteers, a labor-intensive process which has been made more difficult by the challenge of identifying fish as they move underwater. In 2021, Huawei Norway joined with Norwegian technology partners to develop an AI-powered fish trap to help address the problem.
paragraphs.cn: 挪威拥有无数河流，野生大西洋鲑鱼洄游上游产卵。但近几十年来，该国野生鲑鱼种群面临越来越大的压力，来自入侵的驼背鲑（粉鲑）与本地鱼类争夺栖息地和食物，以及气候变化和人类活动。据挪威环境署称，2023年在挪威河流中捕获或观察到超过48万条粉鲑，超过了2024年返回挪威河流产卵的野生大西洋鲑数量。清除入侵鱼类传统上严重依赖志愿者，这是一个劳动密集型过程，而识别水下移动鱼类的挑战使其更加困难。2021年，华为挪威公司与挪威技术合作伙伴联手开发了一种人工智能驱动的捕鱼陷阱来帮助解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: For the first year, a system using an underwater camera and machine vision was tested in the Storelva River near Berlevag, northern Norway, to identify different fish species as they passed through the trap. Trained on tens of thousands of images, the AI system learned to distinguish native Atlantic salmon from invasive pink salmon in real time, with an accuracy of more than 90%. Since 2022, a sorting system designed to distinguish between wild salmon and invasive pink salmon has been installed downstream in the Storelva River, before it reaches the sea. Once a fish is identified, the system opens the gate for native salmon, allowing them to continue upstream to spawn, while diverting invasive pink salmon into nearby holding tanks for removal. Tor Schulstad, administrator of the hunting and fishing association Berlevag JFF in Norway, said native salmon face critical challenges from invasive pink salmon and escaped farmed salmon, while the monitoring systems using AI is helping to stop this and enable future-proof river management.
paragraphs.cn: 第一年，一套使用水下摄像头和机器视觉的系统在挪威北部贝尔莱沃格附近的斯托雷尔瓦河进行了测试，以识别通过陷阱的不同鱼类。经过数万张图像的训练，该AI系统学会了实时区分本地大西洋鲑和入侵粉鲑，准确率超过90%。自2022年以来，一套旨在区分野生鲑鱼和入侵粉鲑的分拣系统已安装在斯托雷尔瓦河下游、入海之前。一旦识别出鱼，系统就为本地鲑鱼打开闸门，让它们继续上游产卵，同时将入侵粉鲑引入附近的暂养池进行清除。挪威贝尔莱沃格狩猎和钓鱼协会管理员托尔·舒尔斯塔德表示，本地鲑鱼面临入侵粉鲑和逃逸养殖鲑鱼的严峻挑战，而使用AI的监测系统正在帮助阻止这一问题，实现面向未来的河流管理。

paragraphs.en:
In the summer time last year, the system helped {{17}} more than 4,000 invasive pink salmon in the Skallelv River, easing the pressure on native species. Services cooperation
These examples illustrate cooperation is no longer limited to the exchange of products. It increasingly involves knowledge, technology and specialized services, with companies from both countries bringing different strengths to address specific needs. h a coastline stretching for more than 100,000 kilometers, including its islands and fjords, Norway has developed deep expertise in the complex ocean and energy industries. 
For generations, the sea has shaped Norway's economy and identity, giving the country deep expertise in shipping, offshore industries and ocean technologies.
China, meanwhile, has emerged as a global industrial powerhouse, leading the world in shipbuilding and playing a major role in energy and advanced manufacturing.
As these industries become greener and smarter, demand is growing for new technologies and specialized expertise.
For Norway, this opens a new avenue for cooperation with China, bringing not only products, but also knowledge, technology and digital solutions developed through decades of experience in demanding ocean and energy industries.
That opportunity comes into focus this year at the China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS), where Norway is the Guest Country of Honor. The event runs from September 9 to 13 in Beijing.
At its national pavilion, Norwegian companies showcase services and solutions focusing on green energy, digital technology, healthy living products and premium nutrition.
The ambition goes beyond selling individual products. Henning Kristoffersen, commercial counsellor at the Norwegian Embassy in China and director of Innovation Norway China, said Norwegian companies hope to move from offering individual products to providing more comprehensive solutions, and from one-off transactions to long-term cooperation.
China is Norway's most important trading partner in Asia. Kristoffersen said the two countries have complementary strengths in areas including maritime industries, energy and sustainable development, while the CIFTIS offers a platform for Norwegian companies to expand their business networks and build long-term partnerships.
Greener shipping
For DNV, a Norwegian-founded risk management company, that cooperation has been taking shape for more than a century.
It has had a presence in China for nearly 140 years, and its relationship with China's maritime industry began with ship inspection and classification in 1888. It provided independent technical assessments to help ensure that vessels meet required standards.
Today, however, this partnership extends far beyond inspecting ships. As international laws are demanding the ship industry searches for ways to cut emissions, and financiers are also paying greater attention to the environmental performance of vessels, DNV is increasingly working with Chinese shipbuilders and shipowners on designing and building the next generation of vessels.
But the path toward greener shipping is far from straightforward. There is no single alternative fuel suitable for every vessel and every shipping route. The choice depends on factors including the type of ship, where it operates and whether a particular fuel is available along its route.
That uncertainty creates both technological and financial risks. Many companies have adopted a cautious approach, building conventional vessels while leaving room for future retrofitting.
Chinese shipbuilders and shipowners, however, are increasingly moving directly toward vessels designed to use alternative fuels, according to Norbert Kray, senior vice president and regional manager for Greater China at DNV.
This is where DNV says it can play a role. The company is working with Chinese clients earlier in the process, providing technical expertise, data and analysis to help them assess different technological options. It helps companies navigate uncertainty as they transition to greener shipping.
Kray said China's influence on the global transformation of shipping is significant. As Chinese shipbuilders receive more orders for vessels designed to meet new environmental requirements, decisions made in Chinese shipyards are gradually shaping the future of the global maritime industry.
If DNV illustrates how a traditional maritime service is evolving to meet the demands of greener shipping, Falkor, a company developing industrial software and digital solutions formerly known as Kongsberg Digital, illustrates another direction: the growing role of digital services in managing complex industrial operations.
Deep Sea No. 1 (Shenhai-1), China's first independently operated deepwater gas field, lies beneath the South China Sea. At peak production, the field can supply more than 3 billion cubic meters of natural gas a year, providing energy for about 21 million people.
Operating a gas field deep beneath the surface leads to challenges that are difficult to see and even harder to manage.
On the seabed, temperatures can fall to around 3 degrees Celsius. Low temperatures, combined with the mixture of gas, water and other fluids moving through subsea pipelines, can create risks including hydrate formation and unstable flow.
In such an environment, operators cannot simply wait for something to go wrong before responding.
This is where the Norwegian company steps in, using a digital model to create a virtual representation of the gas field's highly complex physical operations.
This can simulate different operating conditions, collect data and give engineers a clearer picture of the operation, helping them make decisions before problems arise.
It can also support decisions about pipeline cleaning, optimize operating parameters and analyze energy consumption.
Sorting salmon
The broader shift in China-Norway cooperation can be seen not only in large industrial projects, but also in efforts to address environmental challenges.
Norway is home to countless rivers where wild Atlantic salmon migrate upstream to spawn. But the country's wild salmon populations have faced growing pressure in recent decades, from invasive humpback, or pink salmon that compete with native fish for habitat and food, and also climate change and human activity.
According to the Norwegian Environment Agency, more than 480,000 pink salmon were caught or observed in Norwegian rivers in 2023, exceeding the number of wild Atlantic salmon that returned to Norway's rivers to spawn in 2024.
Removing the invasive fish has traditionally relied heavily on volunteers, a labor-intensive process which has been made more difficult by the challenge of identifying fish as they move underwater.
In 2021, Huawei Norway joined with Norwegian technology partners to develop an AI-powered fish trap to help address the problem.
For the first year, a system using an underwater camera and machine vision was tested in the Storelva River near Berlevag, northern Norway, to identify different fish species as they passed through the trap.
Trained on tens of thousands of images, the AI system learned to distinguish native Atlantic salmon from invasive pink salmon in real time, with an accuracy of more than 90%.
Since 2022, a sorting system designed to distinguish between wild salmon and invasive pink salmon has been installed downstream in the Storelva River, before it reaches the sea.
Once a fish is identified, the system opens the gate for native salmon, allowing them to continue upstream to spawn, while diverting invasive pink salmon into nearby holding tanks for removal.
Tor Schulstad, administrator of the hunting and fishing association Berlevag JFF in Norway, said native salmon face critical challenges from invasive pink salmon and escaped farmed salmon, while the monitoring systems using AI is helping to stop this and enable future-proof river management.
In the summer time last year, the system helped intercept more than 4,000 invasive pink salmon in the Skallelv River, easing the pressure on native species.
Services cooperation
These examples illustrate cooperation is no longer limited to the exchange of products. It increasingly involves knowledge, technology and specialized services, with companies from both countries bringing different strengths to address specific needs.
The CIFTIS has become a forum for companies to understand where to find common ground, connecting expertise and technology with China's industrial scale and growing demand for advanced solutions.
This year, the CIFTIS is bringing together more than 1,800 companies from around 90 countries and international organizations, showcasing new technologies, solutions and achievements across a range of fast-growing fields, from high-tech and fintech to smart healthcare.
Around 100 promotional events and business negotiations are also scheduled, giving companies from around the world an opportunity to explore partnerships and turn new ideas into practical cooperation.

这一机遇在今年中国国际服务贸易交易会（服贸会）上成为焦点，挪威是本届服贸会的主宾国。活动于9月9日至13日在北京举行。在挪威国家馆，挪威企业展示了聚焦绿色能源、数字技术、健康生活产品和优质营养的服务与解决方案。其雄心不止于销售单个产品。挪威驻华大使馆商务参赞、挪威创新署中国区总监亨宁·克里斯托弗森表示，挪威企业希望从提供单个产品转向提供更全面的解决方案，从一次性交易转向长期合作。

中国是挪威在亚洲最重要的贸易伙伴。克里斯托弗森表示，两国在海事产业、能源和可持续发展等领域优势互补，而服贸会为挪威企业拓展商业网络、建立长期伙伴关系提供了平台。更绿色的航运——对于挪威创立的风险管理公司DNV而言，这种合作已经持续了一个多世纪。DNV在中国已有近140年的历史，其与中国海事行业的关系始于1888年的船舶检验和入级。它提供独立的技术评估，帮助确保船舶符合所需标准。

然而如今，这一伙伴关系远不止于检验船舶。随着国际法规要求航运业寻找减排途径，金融方也越来越关注船舶的环境表现，DNV正越来越多地与中国造船企业和船东合作，设计和建造新一代船舶。但通往更绿色航运的道路远非一帆风顺。没有一种替代燃料适合每一艘船和每一条航线。选择取决于多种因素，包括船舶类型、运营区域以及航线上是否有特定燃料供应。

这种不确定性带来了技术和金融双重风险。许多企业采取了谨慎态度，建造传统船舶的同时为未来改装留出空间。然而，据DNV高级副总裁兼大中华区区域经理诺伯特·克雷介绍，中国造船企业和船东正越来越多地直接转向设计使用替代燃料的船舶。DNV表示，这正是它可以发挥作用的地方。该公司在流程更早的阶段就与中国客户合作，提供技术专长、数据和分析，帮助他们评估不同的技术方案。

它帮助企业在向更绿色航运转型的过程中应对不确定性。克雷表示，中国对全球航运转型的影响力显著。随着中国造船企业获得更多符合新环保要求船舶的订单，中国船厂做出的决策正在逐渐塑造全球海事行业的未来。如果说DNV展示了传统海事服务如何演变以满足更绿色航运的需求，那么Falkor——一家开发工业软件和数字解决方案的公司，前身为康士伯数字——则展示了另一个方向：数字服务在管理复杂工业运营中日益增长的作用。深海一号。

深海一号（Shenhai-1）是中国首个自主运营的深水气田，位于南海海底。在高峰产量时，该气田每年可供应超过30亿立方米天然气，为约2100万人提供能源。在海底深处运营气田会带来难以察觉、更难管理的挑战。在海底，温度可降至约3摄氏度。低温加上天然气、水和其他流体在海底管道中流动的混合物，可能产生水合物形成和流动不稳定等风险。

在这样的环境中，运营方不能等到出了问题才做出反应。这正是这家挪威公司介入的地方，它使用数字模型创建气田高度复杂物理运营的虚拟表示。这可以模拟不同的运营条件，收集数据，让工程师更清晰地了解运营状况，帮助他们在问题出现之前做出决策。它还可以支持管道清洗决策、优化运营参数并分析能耗。三文鱼分拣——中挪合作的更广泛转变不仅体现在大型工业项目中，也体现在应对环境挑战的努力中。

(ECNS) -- "China's advanced digital infrastructure, mature artificial intelligence technologies, and rich practical experience in smart city implementation provide Namibia with a viable and practical development path," said Tonata Itenge-Emvula, Namibian Ambassador to China, on Monday in East China's Shanghai.
The "Explore People-Centered Cities: China's Governance, Global Engagement (Shanghai and Jiangsu)" event, organized by China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs for foreign diplomatic envoys, was launched in Shanghai the same day.
During the event, 30 envoys and diplomats from 20 countries, including Belarus, Bangladesh, and Namibia, visited the Shanghai People's City Practice Exhibition Hall to gain insights into the city's achievements in building a modern people-centered city.
Emvula said that Namibia is currently striving to build a "smart, safe, and inclusive" economy, with smart city development entering a fast track. China's pioneering efforts in data-driven planning and digital government services offers replicable experience and pathways for Namibia, and the prospects for bilateral cooperation are broad.
She added that Namibia, like many other countries, is committed to establishing an efficient, responsive, and accountable public service system. Meanwhile, China's outstanding capacity for long-term national development planning provides a highly valuable reference model for Namibia. Moreover, the multidimensional exchanges between the two countries on policy monitoring and evaluation have contributed valuable ideas for improving Namibia's administrative system.
"These experiences will effectively consolidate Namibia's institutional foundation and provide solid support for our country's sustainable development," she said.
In July 2026, Namibian President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah paid a state visit to China. During the visit, bilateral relations were elevated to a China-Namibia community with a shared future in the new era. The two sides signed nine cooperation documents, outlining a blueprint for future exchanges. Among them, cooperation on smart city pilot projects between the two countries drew particular attention.
Speaking of bilateral cooperation, Emvula expressed the hope that this event would further enhance people-to-people and institutional mutual trust between the two countries, writing a new chapter in Namibia-China relations.

China's first national standard focusing on coordination between artificial intelligence (AI) and human customer service officially took effect on Tuesday, aiming to address common pain points in AI-powered customer services.
The national standard calls for a scientific and reasonable division of responsibilities between AI and human agents.
In recent years, advances in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of AI customer service systems. They can now better understand context, conduct multi-turn conversations, recognize emotions and handle queries in multiple languages, prompting their wider adoption across industries.
Under the new standard, AI customer service should primarily handle standardized and routine inquiries, while human agents should take priority in dealing with complex issues and matters involving safety.
The standard also addresses complaints about hidden or inconvenient options for switching to human customer service. It requires AI systems to provide an easy-to-find access point to human agents and ensure a smooth handover. Once the switch is made, customer information should be transferred to the human agent so that customers do not have to repeat their questions or provide the same information again.
The standard also sets requirements for AI-generated responses to prevent what has been described as "false promises" by AI customer service systems.
AI can automatically respond to general inquiries and provide product information, but such responses should carry clear labels indicating that they are AI-generated, along with appropriate risk warnings.
For issues involving prices, discounts, refunds, compensation or contract changes, AI customer service can explain relevant rules, collect supporting materials and generate service requests. However, final confirmation must be handled by a human customer service agent or through a standardized procedure.
The standard is intended to further clarify the respective roles of AI and human customer service while improving the overall customer experience as AI-powered services become increasingly widespread.

该标准要求AI系统提供易于找到的人工客服接入点，并确保顺畅的交接。一旦完成切换，客户信息应转交给人工客服，以便客户无需重复提问或再次提供相同信息。该标准还对AI生成的回复设定了要求，以防止被描述为AI客服系统“虚假承诺”的情况。AI可以自动回复一般性咨询并提供产品信息，但此类回复应带有明确标识，表明其由AI生成，并附有适当的风险提示。对于涉及价格、折扣、退款、赔偿或合同变更的问题，AI客服可以解释相关规则、收集佐证材料并生成服务请求。但最终确认必须由人工客服或通过标准化程序处理。
